references.text: Describes how the wicked, in their greed, oppress and exploit others, which resembles Jesus' criticism of scribes and Pharisees for exploiting widows' property.
Condemns leaders who mislead the people and exploit the weak, paralleling Jesus' condemnation of religious leaders for their hypocrisy and exploitation.
Jesus warns against scribes who pray long prayers to show off and exploit widows' houses, a direct parallel to the warning in Matthew.
Resembles Jesus' criticism in Matthew by pointing out the hypocrisy of scribes and their exploitation of widows.
